FU-1990 deterministic rollback: workflow **build-image** failed on `master` within 120m of #63 merging. The merge was pin-only (every changed line is a `uses:` pin), so reverting restores the previous action SHAs. A Renovate PR that re-proposes a reverted pin is refused by pin-only-lint check (e) in ci (it stays red until Renovate proposes a newer release). Mechanical lane: `automerge` + `dependencies` → the reflex approves, CI is the gate (ADR-100).

**Reverted PR:** #63 — chore(deps): update actions/create-github-app-token digest to 64ab729
**Failed workflow:** build-image on master (run #25)

reverted-pins: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
This PR contains the following updates: actions/create-github-app-token digest bcd2ba4 → 64ab729
